decision: one exact triangular layer, width 32, heads 4; evaluate only requested final pairs, retaining all intermediate nodes
reason: Dense two-layer width-16 resource smoke requires 28.3 seconds per LncDrug optimizer step; exact compiled block reduction gives only modest warm speedup at the larger graph size. Query-only final computation makes a full 400-step prospective protocol feasible.

classification: One prospective triangular mechanism; runtime versions and architecture resource selection do not count as separate innovations.
